class Vehicle:                   # parent class
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name

    def start(self):
        print(self.name, "engine started")

class Rover(Vehicle):            # child class: a Rover is a Vehicle
    def __init__(self, name):
        super().__init__(name)   # run the parent's setup first
        self.wheels = 6

    def explore(self):
        print(self.name, "exploring on", self.wheels, "wheels")

r = Rover("Pragyan")
r.start()     # inherited from Vehicle
r.explore()   # Rover's own method

Pragyan exploring on 6 wheels
